data.readme:
1. 优化 Switch 2 唤醒的稳定性。
2. 优化 Switch 模式体感的灵敏度。
data.readme_en:
1. Optimized controller wake-up stability for Switch 2.
2. Optimized motion control sensitivity in Switch mode.

data.readme:
1. 新增支持 Switch 2 主机摇晃唤醒。（操作视频：https://b23.tv/t3ozob6）
2. 优化 S 模式的体感效果。
3. 调整移动版 App 连接方式为手动启用：开机后按住配置键 2 秒至配置指示灯闪烁。
4. 修复部分场景调用 amiibo 时导致手柄异常的问题。
5. 优化摇杆无死区的精确度。
6. 修复 S 模式游玩 Online 游戏异常振动问题。
data.readme_en:
1. Added support for shake-to-wake feature on the Switch 2 console. (Instructional Video: https://youtu.be/kLT-fUVxsBU)
2. Optimized the motion control experience in S Mode.
3. Changed the mobile app connection to manual activation: Hold the Profile button for 2 seconds after powering on until the Profile LED blinks.
4. Fixed an issue where using amiibo in certain situations could cause the controller to be abnormal.
5. Optimized the precision of the joystick without dead zone.
6. Fixed an issue with abnormal vibration during online games in S Mode.

data.readme: 1. 新增支持 Switch 2 主机。
